name: 腾讯自选股-金融数据查询
examples_zh: 查询贵州茅台近一年日K线、成交量和MACD指标，并列出最近三次放量上涨日期
对比腾讯控股、阿里巴巴和Apple最近四个季度的利润表、资产负债表和现金流指标
查看沪深300ETF的持仓明细、最新净值和近30日资金流向
examples_en: Query Kweichow Moutai's daily K-line, volume, and MACD for the past year, then list the last three high-volume up days
Compare Tencent Holdings, Alibaba, and Apple across the latest four quarters of income statement, balance sheet, and cash-flow metrics
Show holdings, latest NAV, and 30-day capital flow for a CSI 300 ETF
description_zh:
由腾讯自选股团队提供

查询A股、港股、美股个股/指数/ETF的详细数据，包括：K线/分时、财务报表（三大报表多期查询，支持跨市场批量对比）、资金流向、技术指标、筹码分析、股东结构、分红除权、业绩预告、公司简况、ETF基金数据（详情/持仓/净值）；以及大盘指数、行业/板块行情、板块成份股、板块区间涨幅排行、指数成份股、热搜、新股日历、投资日历等市场数据。

微信搜索 腾讯微证券 小程序，获取更多专业服务～
description_en:
Provided by the Tencent WeStock team

Query detailed data for A-share, HK, and US stocks/indices/ETFs, including: K-line/intraday charts, financial statements (multi-period three-statement queries with cross-market batch comparison), capital flows, technical indicators, chip analysis, shareholder structure, dividends and ex-rights, earnings forecasts, company profiles, ETF data (details/holdings/NAV); as well as market indices, sector/industry quotes, sector constituents, sector interval performance rankings, index constituents, trending searches, IPO calendar, investment calendar, and more.

Search for the “腾讯微证券” mini-program on WeChat for more professional services~
